lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Before the silence, every island carried a little piece of the Current. Do you hear it? The water used to sing.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Wait. The aqueduct went quiet. No… not the Crown.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Everything stopped. I kept waiting for the lights to come back.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Huh? You're still here? I'm Luma. Maybe we can help each other.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: See that receiver? If we can wake one connection, maybe the rest aren't lost.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It worked!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Look! The light is traveling again.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Come on. Let's find out where it goes.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I remember this place.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The water used to reach the gardens from here. I thought we'd never hear it again.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: There's another connection underneath us. Let's see where it leads.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: That's the mark from the lower channel. Will it still answer?

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: STABILITY DIRECTIVE ACTIVE. FLOW INTERRUPTED TO PREVENT INSTABILITY.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Prevent instability? These weren't all broken. Someone shut them down.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I don't remember that symbol. But I think I've seen it before.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I remember that sound.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It meant the whole system was connected. There were lights everywhere.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: But there's something else… something I can't remember.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Whatever happened started there.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: This is the heart of Aero Haven. Three connections feed it.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The intake sends water into the relay.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: The relay carries that energy to the Crown.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: If all three wake, the islands get power. Something still wants them asleep.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Then we'll wake them together.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Intake… relay… Crown!

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: We did it. We actually brought it back.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: I thought I was the only one left. I'm glad you found me.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: UNCONTROLLED GROWTH DETECTED.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: That's coming from Eco Canopy. The Current is still out there. And I don't think we're finished.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Look at this place. The forest isn't dead.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: It's trying to grow.

lines.speaker: Luma
lines.text: Something won't let it.
